versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-xhs-track-creator-for-monitor

- Enables command-line search and retrieval of publicly available Xiaohongshu (小红书 / Redbook) note data by keyword, link, or user.
- Supports four main data outputs: search results, note details, comments, and creator post lists.
- Provides clear input requirements and validation for keyword, URL, and API token.
- Includes extensive documentation on proper use cases, error handling, and common troubleshooting scenarios.
- Designed for research, content analysis, and creator/competitor monitoring, not for SEO or ad targeting.
